content: CHRONICLE_FAILURE_PROFILE v2 PROVISIONAL ACCEPTANCE 2026-05-21. Second seed vector reached PROVISIONAL acceptance after one round of pressure (v1 had eight structural gaps; v2 closed all eight in a single iteration). The harder multi-document case demonstrates the Vector Admission Triad generalizes from bounded single-input to distributed historical state. ARTIFACT QUALITIES: canonical eight-element capture surface restored explicitly (Section 2 titled 'Complete Capture Surface (Canonical Eight Elements)' with one-to-one mapping to prompt_source_tokens v3); state_manifest as JSONB array of {doc_id, sha256} entries freezes multi-document state against asynchronous edits; temporal_window_start and temporal_window_end establish absolute temporal firewall; signature_hash precisely defined as SHA-256 over concatenated normalized text ordered monotonically by doc_id; complete Python loading function (deterministic_load_chronicle_state) with full exception hierarchy (StateLoadingEngineError, ManifestHashMismatchError, BoundaryBreachError); 1.5 percent cosine drift threshold flagged PENDING CALIBRATION against VEC-CAL-002; globally namespaced dependencies (VEC-002-DEP-001 Point-in-Time Ledger Indexer, VEC-002-DEP-002 Independent Validation Audit Engine, VEC-002-DEP-003 Immutable Ledger Constraints); complete canonical Admission Evaluation block with Reason, Blocking ambiguities, Falsification paths list, Dependencies list, Human review required fields populated. SIX SPECIAL ATTENTION AREAS engaged with explicit design choices: (1) Summary compression artifacts handled via post-compression SHA-256 validation hash; (2) Cross-document contradiction handled by refusing semantic synthesis - both blocks incorporated as equal components, resolution punted to audit layer; (3) Recency weighting explicitly unweighted - every token within temporal window has exact mathematical equivalence; (4) Inherited failure labels handled as decoupled metadata rows mapping to profile_id, never part of signature_hash, eliminating recursive classification feedback loops; (5) Profile is explicitly DESCRIPTIVE not predictive or prescriptive - point-in-time diagnostic only; (6) Self-fulfilling identity claim prevention solved with two architectural constraints: strict 90-day decay (is_active_audit_profile=FALSE) plus Anthony's signed override VEC-OVR-001 required to re-introduce. SIX TOTAL ADMITTED-TRANSITION ITEMS per Gemini's closing enumeration: (1) VEC-CAL-002 calibration of 1.5 percent cosine drift threshold via 1000-cycle batch evaluation; (2) Presidio code binding standardizing AnalyzerEngine initialization; (3) total_manifest_tokens verification column addition; (4) Decay interval calibration replacing arbitrary 90-day with empirical decay curve; (5) VEC-OVR-001 cryptographic protocol specification (separate open thread); (6) Pipeline order optimization moving NFC normalization before whitespace/line-ending operations and removing noop encode/decode roundtrip in Python loader. STATUS: PROVISIONAL ACCEPTED. CLOSING EXCHANGE STATE: Gemini's final message offered continued collaboration into the build phase ('let me know when you are ready to transition from provisional specifications into active code execution or to begin calibrating these thresholds against real data'). The exchange closed in good standing; relationship is open for future build-phase consultation.
